name: TestTiFlashFTSPathUsesPrimaryIndexForCommonHandleRange
cases: explain format='brief' select /*+ read_from_storage(tiflash[file_nodes]) */ path from file_nodes force index(idx_path_fts) where fs_id = 1 and (path = '/docs' or path like '/docs/%') order by path

explain format='brief' select * from t where fts_match_word('foo', anchor) and (char_ngram like 'abcd%' or id > 10)

name: TestTiFlashFTSOrderByWithMultipleCoveredConditions
